description: The closed final-report builder is a disconnected parallel abstraction: production buildPreflightReport returns the legacy report and never calls validateAndBuildFinalReport. This dead-end split permits schema tests to pass while the only publishing path emits a different structure, defeating the stated pure-core/effectful-shell boundary.

evidence.snippet: const report = await runPreflight({ checks, timeoutMs, now }); ... return proof ? { ...report, controlledL3: proof } : report;
